title: spec: retarget the four remaining "v11" datings of the #3290 session-alias removal to v16 (.describe() strings + migration rationale)
body:
Split out of #9872 (its delivering PR #9990 fixed the 20 comment-text sites; these four sit on spec runtime-data surfaces the ruling there forbade touching). Provenance: os-dev report on #9872, 2026-08-19; residue re-verified on `origin/main` `b1457eeca` at triage time 2026-08-20.

The #3290 removal of the `ctx.session.tenantId` alias shipped in **v16** (the only release page citing #3290 is `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`; its 16.0.0 upgrade checklist carries the rename step). Four spec-package sites still date it "v11":

- `packages/spec/src/ui/action-params.zod.ts:376` — `.describe()` string: "on the v11 session-alias removal path (#3280 deprecate → #3290 remove …)"
- `packages/spec/src/ui/action-params.zod.ts:409` — `.describe()` string: "removal follows the v11 session-alias removal path"
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts:1555` — migration rationale prose: "the v11 session-alias removal already walked (#3280 deprecated → #3290 removed)"
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/17.action-session-roles-to-positions.ts:23` — same sentence

Notes for the dispatching seat (spec lane):
- The `.describe()` strings are runtime data that regenerate `content/docs/references/ui/action-params.mdx` (marked AUTO-GENERATED — regenerate with the repo tooling, never hand-edit) and flow into `spec-changes.json` / `docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md:317`. Regenerate wholesale, don't patch outputs.
- Text-only provenance correction: no schema shape, acceptance, or public-surface change is in scope — expected `Clause-②: no`. If implementation finds otherwise, stop and report a fork.
- Do NOT sweep other "v11" tokens: two sites date *different* removals to v11 correctly (`content/docs/kernel/contracts/metadata-service.mdx:311`, `docs/audits/2026-07-security-props-liveness-recheck.md:26`), objectui#3290 is a different repo's issue, and CHANGELOG entries are historical records — all verified out-of-population under #9872.
- `content/docs/releases/**` stays untouched (release notes are already correct and are never edited in a code PR).
